Machine Translation (MT) is one of the few NLP technologies that has been widely available online for decades.
MT evaluation has focused on benchmarking systems, or rating individual outputs, using automatic or human ratings of translation quality as ground truth.
Human studies that incorporate MT within the relevant end-user task can help us assess the impact of MT more comprehensively.
guideline: Evaluation through question answering is another way to assess if translations preserve important information and to let users make their own assessments of the impact of errors in their context of use.
